remarks: Palmer Hill Penthouse! Rarely On Market! This top floor corner condo is in the sought after gated Palmer Hill community located on the Old Greenwich/Stamford border. This fabulous, light filled, 2 bedroom/2 1/2 bath condo has an open plan living/dining/kitchen. This home has 2 story cathedral ceilings, custom LED lighting, gas fireplace, wood floors, lots of windows, French doors to the 2 terraces, and custom window treatments. The kitchen has custom cabinets, an island, SS appliances, and custom pantry with a full size washer and dryer. The 1st floor primary bedroom suite has a custom walk-in closet, custom full en-suite bath with dual sinks and oversized shower. A powder room completes the main floor. The upper floor has a 2nd  en-suite bedroom with a custom full bath and custom walk-in closet. The loft area is perfect for an office or studio. This home comes with 2 parking spaces in the indoor garage as well as 2 storage units and a bike storage room. Amenities include a clubhouse, gym with yoga room above, pool, hot tub, fire pit, and business center. Dog Friendly. Minutes to I95 and Metro North. NOT TO BE MISSED! Start living the carefree life!
